name: Landing
data: Supported service cities; actual featured listing projections and counts; informational content.
controls: Location/budget/date/category form; city links; browse; sign in/register; Post; featured open/save; FAQ; honest trust/story/footer links.
completion: A chosen search or safe return action is carried intact to discovery/auth.

name: Authentication
data: Supported provider state, email/password inputs, safe internal return descriptor, generic auth errors.
controls: Sign in, register, Google, reset password, switch modes, close/Escape. Demo entry only in verified emulator development mode.
completion: Session is established; resume the intended action after its remaining prerequisites, without auto-sending it.

name: Shared onboarding
data: Name, city, primary locality; selected concurrent intents; explicit discoverability; progressive optional lifestyle/budget/host details.
controls: Save step, back, skip optional fields, review disclosure, finish essentials, resume original context.
completion: Essential profile and chosen intent state persist; optional skipped values remain unknown.

name: All physical discovery
data: Published/available/active-publisher property cards, kind, price unit, city/locality, freshness and disclosed trust.
controls: Search, city, supported filters, sort, grid/list, continuation, open, save, clear filters.
completion: A property detail opens by listingId while search/filter/cursor/scroll context is recoverable.

name: Rooms/flats discovery
data: Physical room/shared-room/entire-flat listings; roomType, BHK and pricing unit are separate fields.
controls: Supported room/flat filters; newest or unit-specific rent order; card open/save.
completion: Appropriate physical listing is inspected; people are never substituted as room records.

name: People discovery
data: Minimal opted-in eligible team-up/resident cards; actual intent, consented preferences, evidence-qualified fit.
controls: Complete own missing setup, filter, supported rank, open person, save, request/withdraw/respond/message according to relationship.
completion: Open /people/:uid; contextual relationship state remains consistent elsewhere.

name: PG/coliving discovery
data: Managed accommodation with explicit room/bed unit, actual capacity/options, fees and rules.
controls: PG filters, unit-specific rent order, open/save, continuation.
completion: Open the same canonical property detail by listingId, with managed-accommodation fields.

name: Accommodation detail
data: Published projection or authorized owner draft; publisher UID; declared resident linkage; photos; price/deposit/unit; availability; questions; review/freshness labels.
controls: Gallery, save, share, publisher/resident profile, report, Express interest/Request to chat, edit/manage only for authorized publisher.
completion: Member can create a listing-attributed inquiry and consent request, or continue an already accepted conversation.

name: Person/publisher detail
audience: Authorized member; minimal public publisher subset where allowed
data: Authorized profile projection, context scope, intent/residence evidence, availability, known/missing preferences, relationship state.
controls: Save, report, request/withdraw/accept/decline/message, own block/unblock, related available place; publisher view omits unsupported roommate claims.
completion: The correct UID is resolved independently of feed position; no automatic PII disclosure.

name: Saved
data: Typed own bookmarks plus batched authorized entity-by-ID results, unavailable tombstones and original entity kind.
controls: Open, remove save, change entity tab, retry unavailable fetch.
completion: Saved IDs persist; unavailable items never masquerade as empty successful fetches.

name: Connections
data: Own pair-request summaries with version, direction, listing context, counterpart projection and expiry/restriction reason scope.
controls: Accept/decline, withdraw, open person/context listing, message if accepted, see own closed/reopened states.
completion: Communication consent changes are authoritative and reflected for both users.

name: Messages
data: Authorized room list, partner projection, per-member read state, paged messages and optional listing context cards.
controls: Search list, unread filter, open conversation, text/send, attachment upload, retry failed draft, partner/context link, report/block, explicit contact-share request/response.
completion: Delivery is acknowledged by persisted message ID; read state and context survive reload.

name: Notifications
data: Recipient events with event ID, authorized target reference, unread/read state and action freshness.
controls: Open target, mark one/all read, respond to a current consent request; stale targets explain unavailability.
completion: The intended entity opens; opening never silently accepts an unrelated request.

name: My listings
data: All own listing IDs and distinct publication/availability states, actual price, review note and fresh applicant count.
controls: Create, resume draft, edit, open preview/detail, applicants, pause/reconfirm/fill/delete with proper prerequisites.
completion: A selected listing management journey opens by ID; status changes update discovery and related contexts.

name: Listing creation/edit
data: Owned draft version, typed kind/unit/capacity/location/rent/deposit/availability, photos, authorized/resident declarations, amenities/rules/questions.
controls: Photo stage, property details, money/move-in, people/questions, preview, Save draft, Submit for review, Close/discard with unsaved-change decision.
completion: Draft is recoverable; submission is pending review, never announced as published prematurely.

name: Applicants
data: Listing-attributed inquiries with answer snapshot, applicant disclosure, application stage and separate consent state.
controls: Filter, open applicant, review answers, shortlist/decline, select candidate, accept communication explicitly, compare, record owner availability after actual decision.
completion: Consideration decisions persist without silently altering consent or occupancy.

name: Applicant comparison
data: Authorized selected application IDs, known/missing fit factors and actual answers for the same listing.
controls: Add/remove up to configured comparison limit, return to filtered applicant list, explicit shortlist or communication action.
completion: Comparison informs a decision; comparison selection alone persists no tenant choice.

name: Account/profile/preferences
data: Own private account, disclosed card, intent set, locality list, preference draft/version and completion state.
controls: Edit name/bio/work description/city/areas, intent/discovery consent, avatar, budget/type/gender/move-in/lifestyle; preview own disclosure, Save/Discard.
completion: Only confirmed edits persist; related discovery and private entity cache invalidate by UID/version.

name: Identity verification
audience: Account owner/authorized reviewer via staff view
data: Latest and historical submission version/status, supported document types, consent text, declared name, review note and document reference.
controls: Upload private supported evidence, submit, see pending status, correct and resubmit rejected evidence; cancel draft upload where permitted.
completion: Owner sees a real decision; trust mirrors derive from the reviewed version, not a client success screen.

name: Security/privacy/data/outcomes
data: Provider/security state, enforceable disclosure/notification prefs, own blocks, export/deletion jobs, per-intent private outcome declarations.
controls: Reauthenticate/change credentials, logout, consent settings, unblock with warning, request/download export, confirmed deletion, declare housing outcome and choose remaining intents.
completion: Each operation has a persisted result/job state or a clear unsupported status; no fake emails, erasure or tenancy.

name: Help/legal/support
data: Reviewed published content, support channel availability, safe case reference, no fabricated service claims.
controls: Read content, contact support/report with explicit privacy information, return to origin.
completion: Requested information or an acknowledged support case is available; no wildcard redirect substitutes for content.

name: Staff console
data: Capability map, true environment/project, authorized queues/aggregates and paged records; private evidence only for reviewer capability.
controls: Scoped read/search/inspect; permitted moderation/review; real broadcast delivery job; explicit staff grants by administrator; audited history. No pretend purge/reset.
completion: A case/decision/job is acknowledged and cross-page results are consistent; failures retain unresolved state.
